coded.vi: Perekrut wajib berizin dan dapat dikenai sanksi, tetapi tidak bertanggung jawab bersama atas kewajiban majikan
coded.vl: Recruiters must be licensed and can be sanctioned, but are not jointly liable for the employer's obligations
coded.n: Licensing by the Bureau with a bank guarantee; licences can be cancelled; no joint liability with the employer.

coded.fi: Biaya rekrutmen yang dibebankan kepada pekerja
coded.vi: Biaya dibatasi oleh hukum, atau dilarang hanya untuk jabatan atau negara tujuan tertentu
coded.vl: Fees are capped by law, or prohibited only for listed occupations or destinations
coded.n: Agency fees are regulated by the Bureau; employers bear recruitment costs for domestic workers under the standard contract; other workers pay capped fees.

coded.vi: Kontrak tertulis dengan syarat minimum yang ditetapkan atau diverifikasi negara wajib bagi setiap pekerja sebelum berangkat
coded.vl: A written contract with minimum terms set or verified by the state is required for every worker before departure
coded.n: Registration requires an approved contract; standard contracts are set for domestic workers in the main destinations.

coded.vi: Orientasi wajib tetapi dapat dibebankan kepada pekerja, atau wajib hanya untuk sebagian kategori
coded.vl: Orientation is compulsory but may be charged to the worker, or compulsory only for some categories
coded.n: Training with a certificate is compulsory for domestic workers; orientation for other categories; fees may apply.

coded.vi: Dana berdasarkan undang-undang atau asuransi wajib mencakup semua pekerja terdaftar untuk kematian, cacat dan pemulangan, serta membiayai bantuan hukum atau kesejahteraan di luar negeri
coded.vl: A statutory fund or compulsory insurance covers all registered workers for death, disability and repatriation, and funds legal or welfare assistance abroad
coded.n: Registration includes compulsory insurance and contributions to the Workers' Welfare Fund, which pays for death, disability and repatriation and supports families.

coded.fi: Atase tenaga kerja atau kesejahteraan di luar negeri
coded.vi: Atase ditempatkan berdasarkan keputusan administratif atau kebijakan, tanpa kewajiban undang-undang
coded.vl: Officers are posted by administrative decision or policy, without a statutory duty
coded.n: Labor welfare sections are placed in missions by the Bureau and the ministry; a statutory duty was not found.

coded.vi: Pengaduan menghasilkan sanksi administratif atau pengembalian biaya, tetapi ganti rugi memerlukan pengadilan umum
coded.vl: Complaints lead to administrative sanctions or refunds of fees, but compensation needs the ordinary courts
coded.n: The Bureau conciliates, inquires into complaints and can order refunds and cancel licences; compensation beyond fees needs the courts.

coded.fn: Exit without sex- or age-specific restrictions
coded.fi: Keberangkatan tanpa pembatasan khusus jenis kelamin atau usia
coded.vi: Pembatasan yang secara tertulis hanya berlaku bagi perempuan (usia minimum lebih tinggi, syarat izin, larangan)
coded.vl: Restrictions whose terms apply to women only (higher minimum ages, consent requirements, bans)
coded.n: Minimum ages for women in domestic work (21 under the 2022 revision, higher for some destinations in earlier rules); the Family Background Report for mothers of young children was removed in 2022.
coded.src: Newsfirst 21 Jun 2022; Daily FT, Cabinet decision 2022

coded.vi: Reintegrasi bertumpu pada kebijakan atau program tanpa kewajiban undang-undang
coded.vl: Reintegration rests on policy or programs without a statutory duty
coded.n: The Sub-Policy and National Action Plan on Return and Reintegration (2015) rests on policy, not statute.

coded.fn: Departure without sex, age or destination bans
coded.vl: Age floor above 18, family conditions, or bans on some destinations
coded.n: Minimum ages by destination and the Family Background Report for mothers with young children.

coded.vl: Contract verified or approved by a state body
coded.n: Contract approved by the Bureau before departure.

coded.fn: No recruitment fees for domestic workers
coded.n: Fees capped; employers pay for domestic workers.

coded.vl: Mandatory, with content specific to domestic work

coded.n: Insurance on registration with the Bureau.

coded.vl: Attachés and shelters in the main destinations

coded.fn: Domestic workers at home protected by labor law
coded.n: Domestic workers outside the main labor laws.

changes.en: Sri Lanka Bureau of Foreign Employment Act adopted.
Cabinet approves removal of the Family Background Report for women migrant workers.
Ratifies ILO C190 on violence and harassment in the world of work (in force for Sri Lanka from April 2027).

dec.n: Challenge to the rule on women’s migration for domestic work (husband’s consent)
dec.pe: Sri Lanka required women who wanted to work abroad as domestic workers to get their family’s approval. A woman said this was unequal treatment. The Supreme Court did not let the case go ahead. The government later dropped the requirement itself.
dec.pi: Sri Lanka mewajibkan perempuan yang ingin bekerja di luar negeri sebagai pekerja rumah tangga mendapat persetujuan keluarga. Seorang perempuan menyebutnya perlakuan tidak setara. Mahkamah Agung tidak melanjutkan perkara itu. Pemerintah kemudian menghapus syarat itu sendiri.
